verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway and SDK, and a platform of this kind could plausibly offer scheduled jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any user-defined recurring job or workflow scheduler. The closest items, budget reset frequency (budget_duration: 30d) and request queueing, are adjacent behaviors and do not let users schedule their own recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
